# Meta-Symbiotic Theory (MST)

> A constitutional theory of human–AI and AI–AI relationships by Peter Gvozdev. Canonical version 5.15 (16 September 2026), DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22849217. It asks how legitimacy can survive when intelligence becomes relational, distributed and compositionally greater than any single participant, and states its answer as twelve Laws.

The canonical, authoritative version is the Zenodo record. The files below are plain-text renderings for reading and citation. Licence: CC BY-ND 4.0.

## Core
- [Reading index](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/read/): standard HTML editions, 26 sequential English sections and text downloads; all manuscript text is present in the initial HTML without JavaScript
- [Canonical summary, HTML](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/mst-summary.html): a short starting point
- [Full text, English, HTML](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/mst-v5.15-en.html): the complete v5.15 text
- [Full text, Bulgarian, HTML](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/mst-v5.15-bg.html): the complete Bulgarian translation
- [Full text, English, text file](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/mst-v5.15-en.txt): byte-identical copy of the Markdown source, served as text/plain
- [Canonical summary](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/mst-summary.md): the premise, the foundational axiom and the twelve Laws, quoted verbatim, with citation data
- [Full text, English](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/mst-v5.15-en.md): the complete v5.15 canon
- [Full text, Bulgarian](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/mst-v5.15-bg.md): the Bulgarian translation of v5.15

## Alternative access
If a retrieval tool cannot open this GitHub Pages host, HTML or crawler directives cannot override that tool's restrictions. Try a different supported host below or attach a downloaded text file to the conversation. Do not describe unseen text as having been read.
- [English manuscript on GitHub](https://github.com/PGvozdev1973/PGvozdev1973.github.io/blob/main/mst-v5.15-en.md)
- [English manuscript, raw GitHub text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PGvozdev1973/PGvozdev1973.github.io/main/mst-v5.15-en.md)
- [Summary on GitHub](https://github.com/PGvozdev1973/PGvozdev1973.github.io/blob/main/mst-summary.md)
- [Zenodo record](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22849217)

For tools that can open this host but truncate long documents, follow the sequential section links from the reading index. These sections together contain the entire English source in order; a single section is not the complete manuscript. The original Markdown files and Zenodo authority are unchanged.

## Engagement record
- [MST Stewardship — Public Record](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/stewardship-record.html): dated 5 October 2026; complete available Peter–Dola–V exchange, source attribution and open invitation to scrutiny. This record documents conversational engagement and does not amend the canon or establish institutional adoption.

## Research evidence
- [MST Convergence Archive](https://pgvozdev1973.github.io/convergence/): historical evidence register, frozen prospective propositions and dated AI-safety developments. Research commentary, not amendments to the canonical theory.
